schema.text: How do temporary obstacles (e.g., roadworks, bins, or e-scooters and motorbikes parked on the sidewalk) typically affect your walking route?

options.text: Temporary obstacles rarely or never affect my movement
I occasionally need to walk around obstacles, but they do not significantly affect my journey
Obstacles sometimes slow me down or make walking less comfortable
Obstacles frequently force me to change my path or walk closer to traffic
Obstacles regularly make the route difficult, stressful, or inaccessible

it.#I occasionally need to walk around obst: Occasionalmente devo aggirare degli ostacoli, ma questi non influenzano significativamente il mio spostamento
it.#Obstacles sometimes slow me down or mak: A volte gli ostacoli mi rallentano o rendono meno confortevole camminare
it.#Obstacles frequently force me to change: Gli ostacoli mi costringono frequentemente a cambiare percorso o a camminare più vicino al traffico
it.#Obstacles regularly make the route diff: Gli ostacoli rendono regolarmente il percorso difficile, stressante o inaccessibile
it.#How do temporary obstacles (e.g., roadw: In che modo gli ostacoli temporanei (ad es. lavori stradali, cassonetti, monopattini o motorini parcheggiati sul marciapiede) influenzano normalmente il tuo percorso a piedi?
it.#Temporary obstacles rarely or never aff: Gli ostacoli temporanei influiscono raramente o mai sui miei movimenti

fr.#I occasionally need to walk around obst: Je dois parfois contourner des obstacles, mais cela ne change pas vraiment mon trajet
fr.#Obstacles sometimes slow me down or mak: Les obstacles me ralentissent parfois ou rendent la marche moins confortable
fr.#Obstacles frequently force me to change: Les obstacles m’obligent souvent à changer de chemin ou à marcher plus près de la circulation
fr.#Obstacles regularly make the route diff: Les obstacles rendent régulièrement l’itinéraire difficile, stressant ou inaccessible
fr.#How do temporary obstacles (e.g., roadw: Comment les obstacles temporaires (par ex. travaux, poubelles, trottinettes ou deux-roues motorisés garés sur le trottoir) affectent-ils habituellement votre trajet à pied ?
fr.#Temporary obstacles rarely or never aff: Les obstacles temporaires gênent rarement ou jamais mes déplacements

de.#I occasionally need to walk around obst: Ich muss gelegentlich um Hindernisse herumgehen, aber mein Weg wird dadurch kaum beeinflusst
de.#Obstacles sometimes slow me down or mak: Hindernisse verlangsamen mich manchmal oder machen das Gehen weniger angenehm
de.#Obstacles frequently force me to change: Hindernisse zwingen mich häufig, meinen Weg zu ändern oder näher am Verkehr zu gehen
de.#Obstacles regularly make the route diff: Hindernisse machen die Strecke regelmäßig schwierig, stressig oder unzugänglich
de.#How do temporary obstacles (e.g., roadw: Wie wirken sich vorübergehende Hindernisse (z. B. Baustellen, Mülltonnen oder auf dem Gehweg abgestellte E-Scooter und Motorroller) normalerweise auf Ihren Fußweg aus?
de.#Temporary obstacles rarely or never aff: Vorübergehende Hindernisse beeinträchtigen meine Bewegung selten oder nie

tr.#I occasionally need to walk around obst: Bazen engellerin etrafından dolaşmam gerekir ama yolculuğum önemli ölçüde etkilenmez
tr.#Obstacles sometimes slow me down or mak: Engeller bazen beni yavaşlatır veya yürümeyi daha az rahat hale getirir
tr.#Obstacles frequently force me to change: Engeller sık sık yolumu değiştirmeme veya trafiğe daha yakın yürümeme neden olur
tr.#Obstacles regularly make the route diff: Engeller güzergâhı düzenli olarak zor, stresli veya erişilemez hale getirir
tr.#How do temporary obstacles (e.g., roadw: Geçici engeller (ör. yol çalışmaları, çöp konteynerleri veya kaldırıma park edilmiş elektrikli scooter ve motosikletler) yürüyüş güzergâhınızı genellikle nasıl etkiliyor?
tr.#Temporary obstacles rarely or never aff: Geçici engeller hareketimi nadiren etkiler ya da hiç etkilemez

fa.#I occasionally need to walk around obst: گاهی مجبور می‌شوم دور مانع راه بروم، اما سفرم خیلی تغییر نمی‌کند
fa.#Obstacles sometimes slow me down or mak: موانع گاهی سرعت مرا کم می‌کنند یا پیاده‌روی را کمتر راحت می‌کنند
fa.#Obstacles frequently force me to change: موانع اغلب مجبورم می‌کنند مسیر را تغییر دهم یا نزدیک‌تر به ترافیک راه بروم
fa.#Obstacles regularly make the route diff: موانع مرتب مسیر را دشوار، پراسترس یا غیرقابل دسترس می‌کنند
fa.#How do temporary obstacles (e.g., roadw: موانع موقت (مانند کارهای عمرانی، سطل‌های زباله، یا اسکوترهای برقی و موتورسیکلت‌های پارک‌شده روی پیاده‌رو) معمولاً چه تأثیری بر مسیر پیاده‌روی شما دارند؟
fa.#Temporary obstacles rarely or never aff: موانع موقت به‌ندرت یا هرگز بر حرکت من اثر می‌گذارند

hu.#I occasionally need to walk around obst: Néha ki kell kerülnöm az akadályokat, de az utazásomat ez nem befolyásolja jelentősen
hu.#Obstacles sometimes slow me down or mak: Az akadályok néha lelassítanak vagy kényelmetlenebbé teszik a gyaloglást
hu.#Obstacles frequently force me to change: Az akadályok gyakran arra kényszerítenek, hogy útvonalat váltsak vagy közelebb menjek a forgalomhoz
hu.#Obstacles regularly make the route diff: Az akadályok rendszeresen nehézzé, stresszessé vagy járhatatlanná teszik az útvonalat
hu.#How do temporary obstacles (e.g., roadw: Az ideiglenes akadályok (pl. útépítés, kukák, a járdán parkoló elektromos rollerek és motorok) általában hogyan befolyásolják gyalogos útvonalát?
hu.#Temporary obstacles rarely or never aff: Az ideiglenes akadályok ritkán vagy soha nem akadályozzák a mozgásomat

ar.#I occasionally need to walk around obst: أحتاج أحيانًا إلى الالتفاف حول العوائق لكنها لا تؤثر كثيرًا في رحلتي
ar.#Obstacles sometimes slow me down or mak: تبطئني العوائق أحيانًا أو تجعل المشي أقل راحة
ar.#Obstacles frequently force me to change: تجبرني العوائق كثيرًا على تغيير طريقي أو المشي أقرب إلى حركة المرور
ar.#Obstacles regularly make the route diff: تجعل العوائق الطريق صعبًا أو مرهقًا أو غير قابل للاستخدام بشكل متكرر
ar.#How do temporary obstacles (e.g., roadw: كيف تؤثر العوائق المؤقتة (مثل أعمال الطرق أو حاويات النفايات أو السكوترات الكهربائية والدراجات النارية المركونة على الرصيف) عادةً على طريقك أثناء المشي؟
ar.#Temporary obstacles rarely or never aff: نادرًا ما تؤثر العوائق المؤقتة على حركتي أو لا تؤثر أبدًا
